newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Tietmeyer - M3 target a signal of stability.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Tietmeyer - M3 target a signal of stability.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer on Thursday said that its two-year M3 money supply growth target was a signal of stability to markets that could be disturbed in 1998 in the run-up to single European currency.
""This is a clear signal of stability for the markets," Tietmeyer told a news conference.
He added that M3 money supply measure remained the best indicator for monetary policy.
